answers.core: This requires modifications to the core.
answers.workaround: As far as I know there is no way to modify X and Y FOVs or frustrum sizes or the view transform individually in a script, as Godot only exposes one FOV/frustrum size, and only allows for getting the view transform, which is computed by the engine using the given FOV/frustrum size.

title: Allow for setting the X and Y FOV/frustrum sizes independently, and/or modifying the view transform
